_meta.what_this_is: A small bake-off: three systems each run K=5 times on the same 6 tasks, pass/fail per trial. The question of this module: if you rank the three on ONE run each (N=1), do you get the same winner as when you ask which one passes all 5 (pass^k)? No.
_meta.systems: Neutral ids model-a/b/c with descriptive display names. 'steady' is reliable but not the highest average; 'streaky' has the highest average per-trial rate but rarely passes all five; 'weak' loses on both. The names describe the fixture; a real bake-off would carry vendor model ids.
_meta.trials_are: A FIXTURE. Each inner list is the 5 pass/fail outcomes for one (system, task), in trial order. trial[0] is 'the single run' used for the N=1 verdict. Stored, not generated, so trials.py runs offline and prints the same numbers; a real run calls a model K times per task, costs money, and varies.
_meta.the_trap: streaky aces its single run (6/6) so N=1 crowns it, but it passes all 5 on only 1 of 6 tasks. steady wins on all-5 reliability. Same data, opposite winner, depending on which question you ask.
